headline._: A quiet day. Nothing new moves the story; still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed: no primary statement is captured.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Nothing new. The compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October; no primary on Dream's report.
headline.researcher: No source published on the day; the pipeline's wakes did not run on 1 November (the correspondent's catch-up note). Nothing added to the ledger.
